title: Bharat Buranji Vol. 3 (University Textbook on Indian & Regional Historiography)
author: Dr. Jogendranath Phukan, Diptiprasad Barua & Suryakanta Borpujari
description: Comprehensive historiographical volume published by the Department of History, Gauhati University, authored by leading Tai-Ahom scholars Dr. J. N. Phukan and Diptiprasad Barua. It provides rigorous academic analysis of Northeast Indian state formation, trans-Himalayan trade routes, Tai political systems, and the intersection between regional Assam chronicles and pan-Indian history.
